purpose: Production-scoped structural candidate after independent r001 quick-review repair. Requires all seven evidence gates and separate publication authorization.

criteria.description: Source/export bounds and counts, exact GLB audit, official validator and separately queued semantic rebuild pass.

All-angle improvement over original: unequal supports, nonuniform actual thickness, selective undercuts, irregular shoulder and crest, coherent beds rather than repetitive decorative bands. Broad quiet rock planes and genuine through-opening remain readable in clay. Repair check: no paired ruler-like front ledges, engineered slit-to-band termination, or circumferential plinth grooves; physical recesses must taper locally.
Actual continuous rock volume, through-opening and broadly plausible joint/erosion/bedding relationships; labels do not claim named-site or prehistoric reconstruction.
Isolated immutable attempts, original unchanged, editable source, portable GLB, deterministic generator/config, provenance and same-scale comparisons.
Exact GLB parses using Three.js 0.180.0 with valid bounds and materials.

Actual browser WebGL2 render of the exact GLB with all-angle image inspection, shader/console check, renderer adapter/context and workload recorded. Explicitly distinguish SwiftShader software graphics from physical GPU evidence.

Render one typical and four stress-case candidate instances in a composed ground-contact scene; inspect scale/contact/materials, record submitted primitives/triangles and timing with renderer identity. Physical target-device performance remains outside this scoped correctness finding and unknown.

coverage_justification: 24 azimuths plus all orthographic directions, clay/alternate key, actual triangle wireframe and support/undercut close-ups. Full-angle quick review precedes high-cost polish.

role_budget.role: One focal environment geology prop; 1 typical and 4 stress visible copies. Close inspection 512-1024 projected pixels, typical 128-512.
role_budget.geometry_rationale: Up to 6000 triangles permits selective bedding planes, shoulder cuts and underside thickness. Target is useful form, not filling allowance. No universal file-size rule.
role_budget.texture_rationale: Zero texture in this controlled form study. Refined textures remain possible after structure review.
role_budget.runtime: Three.js 0.180.0 correctness and combined-scene workload in a declared browser WebGL2 context. Software SwiftShader must be identified explicitly; physical target-device performance remains unknown until measured and cannot be inferred.

claim_scope: Evidence-informed stylized time-neutral sandstone arch concept. No named site, specific stratigraphy, formation age or engineering stability claim.

target_runtime_scope.browser: Chromium with version captured in evidence
target_runtime_scope.framebuffer: At least 1024 x 768 drawing-buffer pixels for exact-GLB visual correctness
required_observations: Front/rear and orbit pixels show correct geometry and single-sided materials
Single and four-arch composed-scene submitted primitives/triangles and timing recorded
Software-rendered timing is not a physical-device performance claim
target_runtime_scope.unresolved_target_hardware: No specific physical device or frame-time target was supplied; remains an explicit limitation and blocks claims of target-device performance.
